explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. The proof uses two things. One is `JacobsonSpace.discreteTopology_of_isOpen_singleton_closedPoint`, which is defined in this library at KrullDimension.lean:52, not in Mathlib. The other is `topologicalKrullDim_zero_of_discreteTopology`, which is in Mathlib. Mathlib has `JacobsonSpace.discreteTopology`, but it needs `(closedPoints X).Finite`, so it does not give the open-singleton criterion. Mathlib has no lemma about open singleton closed points of a Jacobson space and no lemma on quotient maps with open fibres over closed points. Searches for `topologicalKrullDim ≤ 0` and `isOpen_preimage` variants turned up nothing relevant.
